postings.title: Application Support Analyst
postings.description:
Why Nasdaq

When you work at Nasdaq, you’re working for more open and transparent markets so that more people can access opportunities. Connections can be made, jobs can be created, and communities can thrive. We want all our employees to have access to opportunity, too. That means planning for career growth, ensuring you have the tools you need, and promoting an inclusive culture where we’re all valued for our unique perspective.

Here, you will work for a global tech leader committed to breaking down barriers to inclusive prosperity. We see technology as a means to free people up to work together more productively and effectively by centralizing data, analytics, and market intelligence.

Here, we’re committed to building a more diverse and inclusive workforce. Not only is it our responsibility to do better, but we also need representative voices to power the fresh thinking that is vital for our business and our clients.

What We Offer

This is a permanent full-time role based in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig following a hybrid work model setup (at least 2 office days per week).

You can expect an autonomous but fast-paced work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward. Every day brings many opportunities to learn & grow and rewards with a global impact we create.

What You Will Do

As an Application Support Analyst, you will be responsible for providing client services and support for the Nasdaq Market Technology product and service offerings. You will be part of the global service desk team that provide 24/7 standard support and emergency support. This include handling of inquiries from users globally, providing user application support and monitoring service delivery.

- Providing day-to-day product support to the Nasdaq Market Technology client base.

- Tracking, following up, and resolving operational, technical, and user-reported issues.

- Performing incident management.

- Monitoring: Application QoS, Subscription processing, System and Market/provider notifications

- Troubleshooting and resolving any issue resulting from monitoring or user report.

- Collaborating with client tech teams to address issues.

- Handling change requests.

- User access provisioning.

- Escalating issues to the appropriate technology teams and senior management when necessary.

- Updating knowledge base systems to deliver accurate troubleshooting guidelines.

What We Expect

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.

- For non-degree holders, at least 4 years work experience in Data Center, Trading, Computer, or Network Operations.

- New graduates with related educational background and internship experience will be considered.

- Ability to effectively use tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SVN, Putty, MS Office (in particular Excel).

- Good understanding of service level metrics.

- Basic data analysis skills.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Solid attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Critical thinking and natural curiosity; a self-learner.

- Excellent problem solving skills. Prior technical background in system/product troubleshooting is a plus.

- Prior experience in similar product support role - Technical & Helpdesk Support or equivalent is a plus.

What Would Be Helpful

- Understanding of financial markets and trading concepts is an advantage.

- ITIL and Six Sigma Certifications are a plus.

- Amenability to shifting schedules as the team operates on a 24/7 basis

postings.title: Assistant Vice President – Technology Risk Management
postings.description:
Are you an established leader within a risk function with experience managing global teams? Do you want to actively contribute and deliver to the team's success as well leading and developing the team - Then this role might be your next step!

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), Technology Risk Management is a senior leadership role responsible for defining and delivering technology risk strategy across Nasdaq’s regulated market infrastructure and technology solutions businesses. The role combines deep business knowledge of the exchanges industry with applied technology, cyber, and operational risk expertise, ensuring technology risks are managed in line with regulatory expectations, business priorities, and Nasdaq’s risk appetite.

The AVP will lead a globally distributed team, engage directly with senior executives, Boards, and regulators, and represent Technology Risk Management in internal forums. This is a hands‑on leadership role, requiring both strategic direction and active involvement in delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Define and implement technology risk strategy aligned to Nasdaq’s Enterprise Risk Management framework and risk appetite

- Apply Financial Market Infrastructure (FMI) and market‑structure knowledge to assess technology risk across the full trading lifecycle and supporting market services

- Lead all aspects of technology risk coverage across regulated exchanges and critical infrastructure, as well as technology solutions businesses including data, analytics, SaaS, cloud, and digital platforms

- Provide senior oversight and challenge across topics including cyber security, cloud, third‑party risk, operational resilience, and technology change

- Support regulatory examinations and ongoing engagement with U.S. and European regulators as required (e.g. SEC, CFTC, ESMA, European national regulators)

- Prepare and present technology risk insights to Boards, executive committees, and senior governance forums

- Drive risk management initiatives for emerging technologies, including AI/ML, digital assets, quantum and cloud adoption

- Lead, coordinate, and develop a globally distributed technology risk team, setting clear priorities and standards

- Partner with and challenge the 1st line operations teams as required to enhance the controls environment

- Collaborate with the broader Group Risk Team, Legal, Compliance, InfoSec and Internal Audit teams to maximise the value of combined assurance across 2nd and 3rd line teams

Required Qualifications

- Extensive validated experience in technology risk, operational risk, cyber risk, or technology leadership within financial services, exchanges / market infrastructure

- Confirmed ability to pair business knowledge of the exchanges industry with technology risk management concepts

- Experience supporting or overseeing regulated market infrastructure alongside unregulated or commercial technology businesses

- Proven experience presenting to Boards, senior management, and regulators in the U.S. and Europe

- Experience managing risk across a portfolio of businesses with varied risk appetites

Technical and Risk Expertise

- Strong knowledge of cyber security, operational resilience, cloud, third‑party risk

- Understanding of critical market infrastructure requirements, including availability, recovery, capacity, and incident management

- Experience governing risks related to AI, digital assets, and cloud technologies

If you have any relevant certifications or qualifications in Technology Risk, Operational Risk, Cyber Security, AI, Digital Risk, or Cloud (e.g. CISSP, CISM, or equivalent), please state those in your resume.

This position is located in Stockholm, Sweden, and offers a hybrid work environment with at least 3 days per week in the office.

Our new Nasdaq Stockholm office is located at Mäster Samuelsgatan 56, right in the heart of the city. The building is easily accessible by public transport—just steps from T-centralen and several major bus stops. Nasdaq is a vibrant and entrepreneurial company where everyone is encouraged to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and take intelligent risks. postings.title: Director, Listings Sales Creative & Pitch Strategy
postings.description:
What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Operations

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of associates responsible for pitch deck production and sales collateral

- Build and manage scalable workflows and intake processes to support hundreds of requests per year without sacrificing quality

- Establish and enforce brand, design, and storytelling standards across all deliverables

- Track team capacity, prioritize projects, and manage deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

Pitch Deck & Collateral Creation

- Own the end-to-end pitch deck creation process: from brief intake through discovery and final delivery, for Nasdaq's Listings Sales Directors

- Partner with Sales Directors to deeply understand their deal context and translate it into persuasive, narrative-driven presentations

- Develop and maintain a library of modular slide templates, data visualizations, and storytelling frameworks that can be rapidly customized

- Ensure all materials reflect Nasdaq's brand voice, visual identity, and competitive positioning

Technology & Innovation

- Champion the use of AI tools, automation, and emerging creative technologies to accelerate production and enhance quality

- Evaluate and implement tools such as AI-powered design agents, presentation automation platforms, and content generation tools to scale the team's output

- Leverage Nasdaq’s GenAI platform and other platforms like Canva or equivalent to streamline creation

- Build and iterate on AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort while improving consistency

Collaboration & Storytelling

- Serve as a strategic creative partner to Listings Sales Directors, understanding each company's listing journey and crafting narratives that resonate with prospective issuers

- Translate data, market trends, and competitive insights into compelling visual stories

- Gather and integrate feedback loops from sales to continuously improve pitch effectiveness

What You Bring

Required

- 6+ years of experience in creative strategy, sales enablement, marketing operations, or a related field

- 2+ years of people management experience leading creative or content teams

- Exceptional presentation design skills with a strong portfolio of pitch decks, sales materials, or visual storytelling work

- Deep expertise in PowerPoint and/or Google Slides; experience with modern design and presentation tools (Canva, Beautiful.ai, Pitch, Tome, etc.)

- Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority requests simultaneously

- Meticulous attention to detail — you catch every misaligned element, typo, and off-brand color

- Strong written communication and narrative structuring skills

- Demonstrated experience working with sales teams to develop persuasive, insight-driven content

Preferred / Big Pluses

- Experience building or deploying AI agents for content generation, design automation, or workflow orchestration

- Canva Certification or demonstrated Canva for Enterprise expertise

- Familiarity with financial markets, capital markets, or investment banking content

- Experience in a high-volume content production environment (100+ pieces of collateral annually)

- Background in visual data storytelling, infographic design, or data visualization

- Exposure to the IPO, listings, or exchange ecosystem

What Success Looks Like

- Your team delivers polished, on-brand pitch materials on time, every time

- Sales Directors feel fully equipped, and never have to worry about the quality of what's behind them

- You have built a repeatable, tech-enabled creative machine that scales with demand

- Narrative frameworks you develop become the standard for how Nasdaq tells its listings story

Note: This role is not client-facing. The Director, Listings Sales Creative & Pitch Strategy works exclusively with internal stakeholders to support Nasdaq's Global Listings sales organization.

Note: This position will be in our New York City Office (NYHQ) 5 days a week.

What We Offer

We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.
In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short-term incentive), and equity (long-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

Nasdaq’s programs and rewards are intended to allow our employees to:

- Secure Wealth: 401(k) program with 6% employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Program with 15% discount, Student loan repayment program up to $10k, Company paid life and disability plans, Generous paid time off

- Prioritize Health: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, Health spending account with employer contribution, Paid flex days to support mental wellbeing, Gym membership discounts

This includes guiding clients through business configuration, supporting delivery projects, and enabling early value realization through high‑quality training and collaboration.

-

postings.title: Verafin - Software Developer Senior Specialist (Network Platform)
postings.description:
The Role 

We're looking for a Software Developer Senior Specialist to join our Network Platform team, reporting to the Sr. Manager – Software Development. In this role, you'll help build the network foundation that supports the Verafin product. Working at the lowest level of infrastructure in the cloud, your projects will have huge impact across the business. 

This team sits at the intersection of cloud networking, security, and platform engineering. Your work will directly support the scalability and reliability of Verafin's entire platform, enabling seamless connectivity across multi-account AWS environments and ensuring robust network boundaries that protect sensitive financial data. 

You'll fit right in if you're hands-on and collaborative, comfortable designing complex network architectures, enjoy working with cutting-edge AWS networking services, and get energy from building foundational systems that enable other teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences! 

What You'll Do 

- 
Lead and deliver large-scale network infrastructure initiatives, including advanced multi-account connectivity solutions using AWS Cloud WAN and VPC Lattice architectures. 

- 
Translate business and platform needs into well-designed, secure, and highly-available network solutions that meet strict compliance requirements. 

- 
Design and implement sophisticated traffic management and content distribution systems that ensure optimal performance across global regions. 

- 
Collaborate closely with security, platform engineering, and development teams to build network foundations that scale with business growth. 

- 
Mentor and support other developers, contribute to technical direction, and raise the bar for network security, performance, and reliability across the organization. 

What You'll Bring 

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. 

- 
2+ years of experience at Nasdaq / Nasdaq Verafin, with 5+ years of professional software development or network engineering experience. 

- 
Proven ability to lead technical work, design complex network architectures, and deliver outcomes in highly regulated financial environments. 

- 
Strong communicator who collaborates effectively with security, compliance, and engineering teams across multiple time zones. 

- 
Deep expertise with AWS networking services (VPC, Cloud WAN, VPC Lattice, PrivateLink). 

- 
Proven skills writing and reading complex infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). 

Nice to Have 

- 
Experience with advanced AWS networking patterns in multi-account, highly-regulated environments. 

- 
AWS Security or Networking certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Security Specialty). 

- 
Familiarity with Disaster Recovery best practices and multi-region failover patterns. 

This position will be located in St. John's, Toronto or Montréal and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.
